meta.name: Draft Party — packs
meta.source: Built from all 35 supplied screenshots (4 batches): tabs, pack names, emojis and counts.
notes: Core catalog from the original screenshots: 35 unique items per pack.
26 selected packs were extended with curated extras (sports, anime, music, movies, games, food, style, internet, party, countries, animals).

Items cut off by the screen edge and therefore missing: one pack after Superheroes (MOVIES & TV), one after Cookies (FOOD & DRINK), one after TikTok Trends (INTERNET), one after Months (MORE, first screen).
PARTY may be missing packs between Wedding Venues and Wedding Ideas - the scroll position skipped that range.
The Months pack has only 12 real month names, so it is filled with Spanish and German month names to reach 35.
Packs flagged verify:true contain in-game cosmetic names that may need a manual check.
Under FREE the screenshots link to the SPORTS and ANIME sections; those packs live in their own tabs here.
